supply_chain_policy.os_packages: resolved inside the digest-pinned base image's configured APT repositories at builder-image creation time; exact dpkg versions MUST be captured as release evidence
supply_chain_policy.texlive_packages: resolved by tlmgr from the digest-pinned base image's configured CTAN repository at builder-image creation time; exact installed local revisions MUST be captured as release evidence
supply_chain_policy.claim_ceiling: The Dockerfile is not bit-hermetic with respect to APT or CTAN repository time. Release evidence records the resolved dpkg and TeX Live inventories; a future builder-system revision may adopt snapshot repositories without changing course content.
